title: Computational pipeline for Kaempferia parviflora polymethoxyflavones against the colorectal-cancer mitochondrial survival network
description: Custom analysis scripts, machine-learning pipelines, molecular-dynamics analysis code, and figure-generation scripts accompanying the manuscript submitted to the Journal of Pharmaceutical Analysis. Includes three-layer transcriptomic target prioritisation (GSE80320, GSE32323, TCGA-COAD/READ), XGBoost regression with nested cross-validation, Random Forest classification, Lasso pharmacophore inference with bootstrap confidence intervals, ADMET integration, and triplicate molecular dynamics analysis with PBC-aware binding-site occupancy metrics.
